Privacy notice

Updated 10 November 2026

This notice describes the public YMG Events website at events.ymgconsultingservices.com. For privacy questions, contact Dante David / Your Magic Genie at hello@ymgconsultingservices.com. The exact legal controller name and account-specific provider terms are being confirmed; this draft must receive that review before a new contact service is published.

When you visit

The website is hosted and protected by Cloudflare, which may process technical connection data such as your IP address, requested page and browser information to deliver and secure the site. The currently published page requests fonts from Google Fonts, so Google receives the technical request needed to provide those files. The hero image is served by the website; the deployed page does not request it from Unsplash. We do not use analytics or advertising pixels. The current site code does not set analytics or marketing cookies; Cloudflare may use essential security features. We are checking the public host for any host-set cookies.

We use technical connection information to operate and protect the website. The proposed basis is our legitimate interest in maintaining service security and availability (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), subject to confirmation by the operator or a qualified adviser.

Making an enquiry

The form on the currently published website prepares an email in your email app. You can review it, edit it and choose whether to send it. The website does not automatically submit or store the form fields. The prepared message may include your name, venue or business, chosen event direction, approximate guest count, timing, budget and any description you add. If you send it, your email provider transmits it to hello@ymgconsultingservices.com, hosted by Google Workspace; your sending address is included in the email. Your email provider and Google may process the message to deliver and store it.

We use an email you choose to send to answer your question, discuss a possible collaboration and, where relevant, take steps you request before an agreement. The proposed basis is taking steps at your request before entering a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR), where applicable; the operator must confirm the basis for other enquiries.

The newer direct-send form present in this repository’s source is not deployed on the public website. It does not describe or change the handling of an enquiry sent through the currently published version. The notice must be reviewed again before that form is published.

Providers, transfers and retention

Cloudflare provides website hosting and security. Google provides the page fonts and, if you send an enquiry email, Google Workspace mailbox services. These providers may process technical information or correspondence outside the European Economic Area. The specific transfer mechanism and safeguards configured for the accounts supporting this website have not yet been verified, so the operator must confirm them before treating this notice as final. See Cloudflare’s privacy information and Google’s privacy information.

The website does not keep a separate enquiry database. Email correspondence is kept in the mailbox only for as long as needed to reply, manage any resulting relationship and meet applicable record-keeping obligations. The operator is confirming provider log retention and any applicable business-record periods; no fixed retention period is stated here without that evidence.

Your choices and rights

You can choose not to send the email draft. You may contact us to request access to or correction or deletion of your personal information, restriction of processing, or to exercise other rights that apply, including objection where the legal basis permits it. You may also complain to the Italian data-protection authority, the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali.

Other YMG websites

Other YMG websites may use different services and have separate privacy notices. This notice concerns the YMG Events website and the email-app enquiry flow currently published there.
